name: heating_coil_refsim
title: Heating coil RefSim model, epsilon-NTU
summary: Reference simulation model of a hot-water air heating coil from the ULiège model bank: a counter-flow exchanger whose duty follows the epsilon-NTU relation, with the overall conductance as the series of the air-side, metal and water-side resistances scaled with the flow rates.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, heating coil reference simulation model, 2008-03-17

verification.summary: Concerns the runnable variant (native file blocked by CS-BUG-HUMIDAIR-PROPS: Density(AirH2O) returns 1E4). Against the EES stored solution: 43 common variables, 3 differ above rtol = 0.001, maximum 4.11e-03 on the humidity ratio (CoolProp vs EES humid air).
verification.reference: EES stored solution in HEATINGCOIL_REFSIM_EES_MODEL_SB080317.EES (48 decoded variables) against the runnable variant heating_coil_refsim_coolsolve.eescode
verification.notes: 43 common variables, 3 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 4.11e-03 (w_su_heatingcoil and w_ex_heatingcoil, 0.00146432 against 0.0014583). RH_ex_heatingcoil differs by 1.58e-03. Both come from the EES and CoolProp humid-air formulations, as in the other humid-air models of the library. At rtol=1e-4, 19 variables differ; the largest after the humidity ratio are omega_heatingcoil 9.93e-04 and c_p_w_heatingcoil 7.84e-04 (water specific heat). Q_dot_heatingcoil, AU_heatingcoil and both pressure drops stay within 1e-4. Five decoded EES names are not variables of the model: a, b, c, M_dot_w_hotwater, W_dot_pump (Diagram-window leftovers, no equation).
